answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond on one oasis plot; it sheds 10 per idle epoch, so sleepers die. A sparrow courier must bring a key-signed reading before the epoch closes. A prism check splits each reading into plot, serial, timestamp; a reused serial or stale timestamp burns the bond. Renewals cost 24+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,021,000 per epoch. A rented-courier ring is flagged and both sides slashed. An honest agent renews once for 24.
